translations.idiomatic: Pan Yue, Miao Zheng, and the Twenty-four Friends ought all to be dismissed alike, to stiffen moral instruction.

sentences.zh: 朝廷善其忠烈，擢為漢中太守。

translations.literal: Court approve his loyal fierce, promote-as Hanzhong Grand-Administrator.
translations.idiomatic: The court approved his loyalty and courage and promoted him to Grand Administrator of Hanzhong.

sentences.zh: 趙王倫死，既葬，纘以車轢其塚。

translations.literal: Prince Zhao Lun die, already bury, Zuan with cart roll his mound.
translations.idiomatic: After Prince Zhao Sima Lun died and was buried, Yan Zuan had a cart driven over his tomb.

sentences.zh: 時張華兄子景後徙漢中，纘又表宜還。

translations.literal: Time Zhang Hua elder-brother son Jing afterward move Hanzhong, Zuan again memorial fitting return.
translations.idiomatic: Zhang Jing, nephew of Zhang Hua's elder brother, was later transferred to Hanzhong; Yan Zuan again memorialized that he ought to be recalled.

sentences.zh: 纘不護細行，而慷慨好大節。

translations.literal: Zuan not guard petty conduct, yet magnanimous value great integrity.
translations.idiomatic: Yan Zuan scorned petty scruples but was magnanimous and prized great integrity.

sentences.zh: 卒于官，時年五十九。

translations.literal: Die at office, time year fifty-nine.
translations.idiomatic: He died in office at fifty-nine.

sentences.zh: 纘五子，皆開朗有才力。

translations.literal: Zuan five sons, all open bright have talent strength.
translations.idiomatic: Yan Zuan had five sons, all open in temperament and capable.

sentences.zh: 長子亨為遼西太守，屬王濬自用其人，亨不得之官。

translations.literal: Eldest son Heng as Liaoxi Grand-Administrator, subordinate Wang Jun self-use his persons, Heng not attain go office.
translations.idiomatic: The eldest son, Heng, was appointed Grand Administrator of Liaoxi, but Wang Jun, to whom he was subordinate, installed his own men, so Heng never took up the post.

sentences.zh: 依青州刺史苟晞，刑政苛虐，亨數切諫，為晞所害。

translations.literal: Rely Qingzhou Governor Gou Xi, punishments government harsh cruel, Heng repeatedly sharp remonstrate, by Xi what harm.
translations.idiomatic: He attached himself to Governor Gou Xi of Qingzhou, whose legal regime was harsh; Heng remonstrated sharply several times and was murdered by Gou Xi.

sentences.zh: 史臣曰：湣懷之廢也，天下稱其冤。

translations.literal: Historian-minister say: Minhuai's deposing, under-heaven call his wrong.
translations.idiomatic: The historian says: When Minhuai was deposed, the realm pronounced it a miscarriage of justice.

sentences.zh: 然皆懼亂政之參夷，懾淫嬖之凶忍，遂使謀臣懷忠而結舌，義士蓄憤而吞聲。

translations.literal: Yet all fear disorder-government's kin-extinction, tremble debauched-favorites' fierce cruel, thereupon cause plotting ministers harbor loyalty yet knot tongue, righteous gentlemen store wrath yet swallow voice.
translations.idiomatic: Yet all dreaded the wholesale slaughter of lawless rule and quailed before the cruelty of debauched favorites, so planning ministers nursed loyalty yet sealed their lips and men of principle hoarded rage yet held their tongues.

sentences.zh: 閻續伯官既微于侍郎，位不登於執戟，輕生重義，視死如歸，伏奏而待嚴誅，輿棺以趨鼎鑊，察言觀行，豈非忠直壯乎！

translations.literal: Yan Xu Bo office already humble-than gentleman-attendant, rank not ascend at halberdier, light life weight righteousness, view death like return, prostrate memorial await harsh execution, cart coffin toward cauldron-boil, examine speech observe deed, how-not loyal straight stalwart!
translations.idiomatic: Though Yan Xu Bo held office more lowly than a gentleman-attendant and never rose to halberdier rank, he prized duty above life and treated death as home; he laid his memorial and awaited harsh sentence, shouldered his coffin and marched toward the cauldron. Judging his words and deeds, was he not magnificent in loyalty and integrity?

sentences.zh: 顧視晉朝公卿，曾不得與其徒隸齒也。

translations.literal: Turn-view Jin court dukes ministers, once not attain with his foot-slaves rank-teeth.
translations.idiomatic: Measured against the dukes and ministers of Jin, they could not even be classed with his menials.

sentences.zh: 茂伯篤終，哭王經以全節。

translations.literal: Maobo faithful end, weep Wang Jing thereby complete integrity.
translations.idiomatic: Maobo kept faith unto death, mourning Wang Jing to preserve his integrity.

sentences.zh: 休然追遠，理鄧艾以成名。

translations.literal: Xiuran pursue distant, straighten Deng Ai thereby complete name.
translations.idiomatic: Xiuran reached back to right ancient wrongs, settling Deng Ai's case to win renown.

sentences.zh: 故得義感明時，仁流枯骨。

translations.literal: Therefore attain righteousness move enlightened age, benevolence flow withered bones.
translations.idiomatic: Thus they stirred righteousness in an enlightened age and extended kindness even to dry bones.

sentences.zh: 雖硃勃追論新息，欒布奏事彭王，弗之尚也。

translations.literal: Although Zhu Bo pursue discuss Xinxi, Luan Bu memorialize affair Prince Peng, not them surpass.
translations.idiomatic: Though Zhu Bo's retrospective plea for the Marquis of Xinxi and Luan Bu's memorial for Prince Peng were famed, they do not surpass these deeds.

sentences.zh: 贊曰：感義收會，篤終理艾。

translations.literal: Praise say: moved duty gather Hui, faithful end straighten Ai.
translations.idiomatic: The verdict runs: Moved by duty he gathered in Zhong Hui; keeping faith to the end he settled Deng Ai.

sentences.zh: 道既相侔，名亦俱泰。

translations.literal: Way already mutually match, name also together great.
translations.idiomatic: Their paths were alike; their reputations rose together in glory.

sentences.zh: 續伯區區，輿櫬陳謩。

translations.literal: Xubo petty-petty, cart bier set-forth plan.
translations.idiomatic: Xubo alone, low in station, bore his bier and set forth his counsel.

sentences.zh: 偪茲淫嬖，弗遂良圖。

translations.literal: Press these debauched favorites, not accomplish good plan.
translations.idiomatic: Crushed by those debauched favorites, sound designs came to nothing.

sentences.zh: 啜其泣矣，何嗟及乎！

translations.literal: Sip their weep alas, what sigh reach!
translations.idiomatic: They sob their tears away; too late then for vain lament!
